text: Cross-repo edge data model (optional repoId on connections)
description: Extend ConnectionSchema with an optional repoId: defined ⇒ the target aim lives in an external repo. Single code path through value-calc and rendering (no separate externalConnections array). External edges are stored only on the local supported (parent) side; supportedAims stays local-only (the external supporter keeps no back-reference). Thread repoId through create/update/connect paths and persistence.

status.comment: Cancelled 2026-09-20: repo-level links are the final model, each linked repo stays a black box. An optional repoId on a connection exists only to target a SPECIFIC external aim, which is exactly the opacity-breaking design we are not building. Superseded by the {repoId}-only supportingRepos edge (8ae69400).

reflection: Cancelled, not parked: Felix confirmed repo-level-only as the standing decision (black-box repos), so the aim-level edge data model has no revival path.
